note.zh-TW: 與負債比率的換算關係在解說中補上：權益倍數等於 1 除以（1 減負債比率）（設計說明見 T38）。
note.en: The explanation gives the conversion from the debt ratio: the equity multiplier equals 1 divided by (1 minus the debt ratio) (see the design note T38).

definition.zh-TW: 資產總計是權益的幾倍，看公司用股東的錢撐起多大的資產。倍數越高表示借的錢越多；它和負債比率是同一件事的兩種看法。
definition.en: Total assets as a multiple of equity: how large an asset base the shareholders' money supports. A higher multiple means more borrowing; it and the debt ratio are two views of the same thing.

ifrsNote.zh-TW: IFRS 不定義財務比率；這個名稱是國際通用說法，計算口徑以指標登錄檔的版本為準。
ifrsNote.en: IFRS does not define financial ratios. The name follows international usage; the calculation basis is the version in the ratio registry.
